title: 787daily
description: Puerto Rico news (English summaries + links) and live island conditions, read-only over MCP.
summary: Puerto Rico news (English summaries + links) and live island conditions, read-only over MCP.
offersHint: Puerto Rico news (English summaries + links) and live island conditions, read-only over MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.787daily.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_daily_briefing
toolsPreview.description: Today's Puerto Rico briefing: the latest English news summaries from 787daily, each linked back to the original Spanish-language source. Returns summaries + links only.

toolsPreview.name: keyword_search_news
toolsPreview.description: Keyword search over 787daily's Puerto Rico news archive by title/summary and optional section. Returns matching article summaries with links to the originals. For semantic/vector search, use search_news.

toolsPreview.name: search_pr_news
toolsPreview.description: Legacy alias for keyword_search_news. Keyword search over title/summary and optional section; use search_news for semantic/vector search.

toolsPreview.name: list_sections
toolsPreview.description: List 787daily's news sections (categories) and what each covers.

toolsPreview.name: list_condition_spots
toolsPreview.description: List every 787daily Puerto Rico adventure spot with its activities and the CURRENT activity-window verdict (good/fair/marginal/poor, scored from buoy + marine data at the site's last build). Use a spot's key with get_conditions for live numbers.

toolsPreview.name: get_conditions
toolsPreview.description: Live conditions at a Puerto Rico spot from public data (Open-Meteo): wave height/period/direction, sea-surface temp, air temp, and wind. Use list_condition_spots for valid keys.

toolsPreview.name: get_town_weather
toolsPreview.description: Current conditions plus a 24-hour forecast for any of Puerto Rico's 78 municipalities, by slug (e.g. 'san-juan', 'ponce', 'rio-grande'). Hourly temperature (°F), wind (mph + direction), and condition labels from Open-Meteo via 787daily's cached endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: search_news
toolsPreview.description: Semantic vector search over 787daily's Puerto Rico news corpus. Returns the most relevant article matches (title, URL, topic, date, score) for a free-text query — without generating an answer. Use this when you want matching articles rather than a synthesized answer; use ask() when you want a grounded narrative answer.

toolsPreview.name: ask
toolsPreview.description: Ask a question about Puerto Rico and get a grounded, cited answer synthesized from 787daily's own news corpus. Returns { answer, sources, refused }. If the question is off-topic or not covered by the corpus the answer is refused cleanly — no outside knowledge is ever used. For raw article matches without generation, use search_news() instead.

toolsPreview.name: get_by_entity
toolsPreview.description: Return 787daily articles that mention a specific named entity (person, organization, or place), newest-first. Match is on the entity's canonical name (case-insensitive). Returns { name, count, articles[] }.

toolsPreview.name: get_by_municipality
toolsPreview.description: Return 787daily articles that mention a specific Puerto Rico municipality, newest-first. Accepts canonical names and common variants (e.g. 'San Juan', 'Ponce', 'Rincón'). Returns { name, count, articles[] }.

toolsPreview.name: get_cost_of_living
toolsPreview.description: Puerto Rico cost-of-living figures from the U.S. Census ACS 5-Year Estimates: median gross rent, median household income, and median home value for the island, the US (comparison), and any of the 78 municipios. Vintage-labeled; suppressed small-town estimates are null.

toolsPreview.name: get_safety_stats
toolsPreview.description: Puerto Rico reported crime statistics (PRPD Type I via the Instituto de Estadísticas): island year-to-date totals vs the same period last year, monthly homicide series, victim demographics, and per-municipio counts with violent-crime rates per 10k residents (prior full year). Reported incidents, not victimization surveys.
